EmailTemplate.name: New Sports Journalism Degree
EmailTemplate.subject: Experience Cronkite sports at ASU
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thanks for your interest in Arizona State University’s Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication.
We’re very excited to share more information about our new sports journalism degrees at http://sportsjournalism.jmc.asu.edu/.
The Cronkite School has a robust sports journalism program at both the undergraduate and graduate levels. Our program’s foundation is founded in academic curriculum, professional experiences and location.
We’re based in the heart of Phoenix, a major metropolitan city, with access to a number of professional sporting venues for our students to cover. Not only is Phoenix a hub for MLB Spring Training each year, but we are also one of a handful of U.S. cities that has five major sports teams: MLB, NBA, NFL, NHL and WNBA.
The Cronkite School has established sports bureaus in both Phoenix (http://sportsjournalism.jmc.asu.edu/phoenix-sports-bureau.php) and Los Angeles (http://sportsjournalism.jmc.asu.edu/los-angeles-sports-bureau.php), offering students semester-long experiences covering professional teams for various partners like MLB.com and the Pac-12 Network.
Learn more about the Cronkite School’s undergraduate admission requirements (https://cronkite.asu.edu/undergrad/admissions), and explore our 11 professional programs (https://cronkite.asu.edu/professional-programs).
We also encourage you to check out Experience Cronkite Sports, a sports program featurette produced by our students at https://vimeo.com/121480315.
For more information about the Cronkite School, please call me at {!User.Phone}.
Sincerely,
{!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName} {!User.Title} Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication
If you would like any additional information or have questions related to this subject, please reply to this email.
